data.rationale: The proposal follows the same four-stage procedure in the right order with the right core parameters (nationality, country, month), but it omits the allowed-stay lookup, hardcodes "allowed stay not specified" in the note template, and lists "visa info" and "holidays" as parameters even though they are scraped outputs, so an automation built from it would produce a wrong or incomplete note.
